text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year, Trainer! ♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Did you celebrate with any traditional<n>cuisine? I
tried making a full box of<n>osechi dishes.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I have plenty to share, if you'd like<n>me to bring you
any.
choice_data_list:
It must've taken a lot of work to make everything
yourself.

It must've taken a lot of work to make everything
yourself.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It was a challenge, yes. But I wanted<n>to immerse
myself entirely in the local<n>New Year's customs.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Besides, this will be a year of<n>challenges. An early
start will only<n>help me in the long run.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I will be facing my venerated seniors.<n>Every type of
preparation is<n>invaluable.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: So yes—on that note...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The year's tone is set on day one, as<n>they say.
Why don't we talk about<n>our aspirations for the
upcoming<n>year?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
What would you like to accomplish<n>this year,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Racing knowledge... I see.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Races like the Classics demand more<n>than just
brute strength alone.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Please enlighten me with your tactical<n>insight.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Would you be willing to start right<n>away?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder looks so motivated<n>that I end up
spending the whole of<n>New Year's Day poring over
race<n>films with her—and snacking our way<n>through
her handmade dishes.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
A wise choice—I wouldn't want to<n>miss any races
due to poor<n>conditioning.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I will do my best to attend<n>to my own
health as well... but<n>Trainer, how about yours?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I hope you aren't using New Year's<n>as an excuse
to stay up late and<n>overeat, are you?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We spend the rest of the day in a<n>deep discussion
over healthy lifestyle<n>practices.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hmm... My skills, you say?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Now that you mention it, I've been<n>wanting to work
on shortening my<n>stride.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With a little more practice, Grass<n>Wonder's stride
could become the<n>best weapon in her arsenal.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
While small fast steps aren't<n>sustainable in longer
races, they<n>would give quick acceleration for a<n>last
spurt.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Master oneself. I will fight back my<n>instincts and
develop a controlled<n>path to victory.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder's competitive spirit is<n>in full force,
so we decide to get a<n>jump start on training.
